About the project

Group 33 is working as a website team on an archaeology exhibition project. The public repository records the group’s content, design and decisions.

The project has no mandatory pull-request or approval process. Group members will decide how to plan changes, review work, resolve conflicts and determine when material is ready to publish.

Every commit to main is deployed automatically and becomes public.
